messages:
Lenora: Quick sync — Meridian exec brief locked for Tue Mar 28 09:00 PST. Need final slide deck + risk table today. Who can own which sections?
Samir: I can own slides 2–4 (health metrics, onboarding status, blockers). Will pull latest dashboards.
Jorge: I'll do the renewal ask + exec summary slide. Need the latest ARR/usage delta from Maya. @Maya can you confirm?
Maya (Meridian): Maya here — will send adoption numbers and the internal exec list by EOD. Also flagging two open integration bugs we discussed.
Elaine: Enablement will run a 15m demo during the exec readout. I need the runbook and one success customer quote. Tagging @Samir for the runbook updates.
Samir: copying runbook snippet below and will update with new metrics.
Samir: ```
- Slide 1: TL;DR + ask (owner: Lenora)
- Slide 2: Account health snapshot (owner: Samir)
  - DAU, MAU, avg latency, error rate, infra cost delta
- Slide 3: Onboarding & adoption (owner: Samir)
  - remaining tasks, expected completion dates, blockers
- Slide 4: Support/bugs impacting adoption (owner: Samir)
- Slide 5: Renewal outlook & ask (owner: Jorge)
- Slide 6: Enablement outcomes + next steps (owner: Elaine)
- Appendix: detailed runbook, logs, escalation contacts
```
Lenora: Nice. Two operational asks: 1) capture renewal risk level (low/med/high) with concrete mitigations; 2) a one-line exec-friendly ask (financial/commitment).
Jorge: For renewal risk I'm leaning MED-HIGH given the open integration items + slower-than-expected adoption. Proposed mitigations: patch schedule + dedicated SRE window + 1:1 exec demo. I'll put owners and ETA on the slide.
Maya (Meridian): We can commit to a 30-day patch window if Redwood confirms SLA for the patch deployment. Also want clearer success criteria for upgrade.
Lenora: Action items (short):
- Samir: update slides 2–4 with metrics + blocker owners (due today 6pm PT)
- Jorge: draft renewal ask + mitigation plan (due today 7pm PT)
- Elaine: enablement demo runbook + quote (due today 5pm PT)
- Maya: send final adoption numbers + exec list (EOD)
- Lenora: I'll consolidate and do a final deck pass by 8:30pm PT and ping execs.
CS-Bot: Meeting invite created: Meridian Exec Brief — Tue Mar 28 09:00 PST. Deck attachment placeholder created.
Samir: Noting risks: KPI drift on non-prod integration (SRE is block), cost spike after quantization change — adding to risk table with mitigation owners.
Jorge: I'll include a one-line financial ask: "Renewal conditional on resolved integration + 10% committed footprint increase" — open to edits.
Lenora: Keep it softer for execs: "Renewal: target continuation with phased expansion pending integration resolution; ask: dedicated patch window + short-term credits".
Elaine: Also capture enablement feedback themes from pilots: docs clarity, gating checklist, and playbook for integrators. I'll send a 1-slide summary.
Maya (Meridian): Thanks all — will confirm numbers + internal exec slot attendees by 1700 PT. Appreciate quick turnaround.
Lenora: Great. I'll assemble final deck and tag people for review. Ping here when your slide is uploaded.
Samir: Uploaded draft slides 2–4 to the deck — link: https://redwood.internal/s3/meridian-deck-draft
Jorge: Draft renewal slide uploaded. Added mitigation owners and timeline.
Elaine: Runbook + enablement slide uploaded.
Lenora: Final pass started. Will post final deck link and run through outline in #all-hands tomorrow. Thanks team.
